title: Do As I Can, Not As I Say: Grounding Language in Robotic Affordances
fm_models: PaLM 540B (main); Universal Sentence Encoder (skill embeddings); FLAN / smaller PaLM variants (ablation, appendix)
adj_mechanism: Product of LLM usefulness score and learned affordance value selects next skill; iterative planning in language.
adj_relevance: Foundational 'LLM proposes, grounding module disposes' architecture; analogous to VLM social reasoning filtered by feasibility/safety modules.
adj_why_not_direct: No social navigation, no human-aware behaviour.
adj_inherited_by: Cited by corpus VLM-Social-Nav (Song 2025), PaLM-E, NavGPT, Code as Policies, Pan review.

title: LM-Nav: Robotic Navigation with Large Pre-Trained Models of Language, Vision, and Action
fm_models: GPT-3 (landmark parsing); CLIP ViT-L (grounding); ViNG (pre-trained visual navigation model; not a large FM)
adj_mechanism: Modular zero-shot pipeline: LLM -> landmarks; VLM -> node grounding; VNM -> traversability and control; DP graph search.
adj_relevance: Canonical 'compose pre-trained models' navigation architecture reused by VLM social navigation pipelines (VLM semantic layer + learned navigator).
adj_why_not_direct: No humans, no social reasoning; ignores verbs/adverbs such as 'drive past the dog very slowly'.
adj_inherited_by: Cited by corpus VLM-Social-Nav, VL-TGS, PAD, ViLAM, Code as Policies, VLMaps, GNM, Pan review.

title: RT-2: Vision-Language-Action Models Transfer Web Knowledge to Robotic Control
adj_mechanism: Pretrained VLM fine-tuned jointly on web VL and robot data so that action tokens are generated like text (VLA).
adj_relevance: Defines the VLA (I7/F10) end of the integration spectrum; latency (1-3 Hz cloud) and data needs frame the feasibility debate for VLA-style social navigation.
adj_why_not_direct: Manipulation only; humans only as recognition targets; no social navigation behaviour.
adj_inherited_by: Cited by corpus PAD, MUSON, Cai survey, SocialNav-SUB, Pan review.

title: PaLM-E: An Embodied Multimodal Language Model
fm_models: PaLM-E-12B (PaLM 8B + ViT-4B); PaLM-E-84B (PaLM 62B + ViT-22B); PaLM-E-562B (PaLM 540B + ViT-22B); OSRT / ViT+TokenLearner / state encoders
adj_mechanism: Continuous sensor embeddings interleaved with text tokens in a pretrained LLM, trained end-to-end; LLM outputs plans/answers.
adj_relevance: Archetype of VLM as high-level planner and scene interpreter (F1/F7) with discrete skill outputs, and of positive transfer from web-scale VL data.
adj_why_not_direct: No humans as navigation agents, no social behaviour.
adj_inherited_by: Cited by corpus PAD, MUSON, Cai survey; NavGPT; Pan review.

title: Visual Language Maps for Robot Navigation
fm_models: LSeg (CLIP-space pixel embeddings); CLIP text encoder; code-writing LLM (Codex referenced; exact model not stated in main text)
adj_mechanism: Spatially anchored open-vocabulary features enable language indexing of map locations and language-defined obstacle maps; LLM writes navigation code.
adj_relevance: Template for semantic/language maps that social systems extend with human/social layers (e.g., language-defined no-go or etiquette zones); authors explicitly list moving humans as future work.
adj_why_not_direct: Static environments only; no human modelling.
adj_inherited_by: Cited by corpus CoNVOI, VL-TGS, ViLAM, Cai survey, NavGPT, G2-Nav (via search: 'Visual Language Maps').

title: VoxPoser: Composable 3D Value Maps for Robotic Manipulation with Language Models
fm_models: GPT-4 (OpenAI API); OWL-ViT (open-vocabulary detector); Segment Anything; XMem tracker
adj_mechanism: LLM-generated code builds dense affordance/avoidance cost maps grounded by VLM perception, optimized by MPC with fast replanning.
adj_relevance: Direct methodological precedent for VLM/LLM-generated cost or constraint maps (F6/I4) used by social navigation planners (e.g., keep away from groups expressed as avoidance maps).
adj_why_not_direct: Manipulation only; no humans or social norms.
adj_inherited_by: Cited by corpus MUSON and Pan foundation-language-models navigation review.

title: Code as Policies: Language Model Programs for Embodied Control
fm_models: OpenAI Codex code-davinci-002 (main, temperature 0); code-cushman-001; GPT-3 6.7B; InstructGPT 175B; ViLD and MDETR (open-vocabulary detectors)
adj_mechanism: LLM writes executable policy code composing perception and control APIs, with hierarchical function generation.
adj_relevance: Precedent for LLMs producing parameterised constraints/costs/waypoints programmatically (e.g., translating 'a bit to the left' into numbers) — directly analogous to LLM-generated social cost/constraint code.
adj_why_not_direct: No humans or social norms; navigation shown only qualitatively.
adj_inherited_by: Cited by corpus Cai survey and VoxPoser (adjacent); not cited by direct social-navigation notes found so far.

title: GNM: A General Navigation Model to Drive Any Robot
adj_mechanism: Single goal-conditioned visuomotor navigation policy trained on 60-70 h of heterogeneous multi-robot data with normalized waypoint action space and temporal embodiment context.
adj_relevance: Navigation foundation model lineage (GNM -> ViNT -> NoMaD) used as base policies/baselines in VLM social navigation; training data includes SCAND sidewalks with pedestrians but social behaviour is not evaluated.
adj_why_not_direct: No language, no humans in evaluation, no social metrics.
adj_inherited_by: Cited by corpus SocialNav (CVPR 2026, Chu); ViNT/NoMaD (adjacent) build on it.

title: ViNT: A Foundation Model for Visual Navigation
fm_models: ViNT (31M params; EfficientNet-B0 encoders + 4-layer Transformer); image-to-image diffusion model for subgoal proposals
adj_mechanism: Transformer NavFM trained on 80-160 h of cross-robot data; diffusion-proposed subgoals; soft-prompt adaptation to new goal modalities.
adj_relevance: Base/backbone for several VLM social-navigation systems (used for low-level execution) and source of the 'emergent pedestrian avoidance' claim; training data includes SCAND and SACSoN (social navigation data).
adj_why_not_direct: No language, no social model; pedestrian behaviour only anecdotal.
adj_inherited_by: Cited by corpus VL-TGS, BehAV, Cai survey, SocialNav (CVPR 2026), ViLAM, Obstacles-to-Etiquette, G2-Nav.

title: NoMaD: Goal Masked Diffusion Policies for Navigation and Exploration
fm_models: NoMaD (19M params; EfficientNet-B0 + 4-layer Transformer + 1D conditional U-Net diffusion head)
adj_mechanism: Goal-masked Transformer context + conditional action diffusion yields one policy for undirected exploration and goal-conditioned navigation.
adj_relevance: Common low-level navigator / baseline in VLM social-navigation work; demonstrates multimodal action modelling relevant to socially ambiguous multi-action scenes.
adj_why_not_direct: No language, no human modelling, no social metrics.
adj_inherited_by: Cited by corpus SocialNav-MoE, VL-TGS, BehAV, SocialNav (CVPR 2026); Arena 4.0.

title: VLFM: Vision-Language Frontier Maps for Zero-Shot Semantic Navigation
fm_models: BLIP-2 (image-text cosine similarity); Grounding-DINO; YOLOv7 (not FM); Mobile-SAM; ZoeDepth (real robot)
adj_mechanism: VLM image-text similarity projected into a top-down value map, fused with confidence weighting, ranks exploration frontiers.
adj_relevance: Example of VLM as dense spatial scorer (F5, I3) that avoids vision-to-text bottlenecks; directly analogous to VLM path/trajectory scoring in social navigation.
adj_why_not_direct: Object search only; no humans or social norms.

title: NavGPT: Explicit Reasoning in Vision-and-Language Navigation with Large Language Models
fm_models: GPT-4; GPT-3.5 (summaries; ablations); BLIP-2 ViT-G FlanT5-XL (captioning); Fast-RCNN (detector, not FM)
adj_mechanism: LLM as zero-shot sequential decision maker over text-translated observations, with explicit reasoning traces and summarised history.
adj_relevance: Template for LLM-in-the-loop navigation with explainable reasoning (F7/F9) and for the 'vision-to-language bottleneck' later inherited by text-based social reasoning pipelines.
adj_why_not_direct: No humans, no social behaviour, static scenes.
adj_inherited_by: Cited by corpus HA-VLN (2024), HA-VLN 2.0, HCSG; also by Pan foundation-language-models navigation review (00).

title: VL-TGS: Trajectory Generation and Selection Using Vision Language Models in Mapless Outdoor Environments
adj_mechanism: Propose-and-select: generative (CVAE) geometric candidates + VLM visual-prompt selection of semantically appropriate trajectory
adj_relevance: Demonstrates VLM as path critic for conventions of human-centred spaces (crosswalks, pavements); direct template for later social path selection
adj_why_not_direct: No humans in evaluated scenarios; objective is semantic traversability, not interaction with people
adj_inherited_by: Fang et al. 2026 'From Obstacles to Etiquette' explicitly cites VL-TGS as closest propose-and-select work; GSON/OLiVia-style candidate selection
